name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.191: Subtitles start sooner after a file lands. A new episode used to wait five
    minutes before anything happened to it; the arrival window is now one minute by default,
    so a dropped file is picked up while the import is still fresh. Files that arrive together
    are still handled in one cycle, and the window stays adjustable (1-120 minutes) for a slow
    NAS. Already-installed servers keep their existing setting.
